sampling.seed_rule: cell seed + turn number, same for every arm

accounting: Conservative GPU reservation is wall time for model subprocess including load, encode, generate and save. Max600 seconds/cell across12; unspent cell budget is not transferred. CPU rendering/audit excluded and separately reported. No inference call starts with less than15 seconds remaining. If exhausted, export last actual state and mark budget exhaustion.
serialization: Official OTA <think> plus one <tool_call>; every arm can generate own short four-field decision; no gold D or reference layouts.
feedback: Identical current-state mesh/outside/identity/route and workspace proxy checks, recomputed after actual changes. No developer reference outcomes or reference coordinates.
primary: Requested activity proxies plus original identity and new side effects, compared to measured initial failures. Shared surfaces permitted if disjoint work/dining patches and seats; no mandatory new desk. Unknown ergonomics/guest sleep never success.
checkpoint_selection: Final update8; no best-checkpoint choice using dev outputs.
error_policy: Malformed or schema-invalid action counts as rejected attempt, retain raw and report rejection for next turn within original cap. Infrastructure/model exception stops cell, saves last state; no retry. Batch stops on infrastructure failure; no automatically retrained adapter.
